risks.title: Commodity Price Volatility
risks.summary: Commodity prices (aluminum cans, sugar, sweeteners, juice, milk, coffee, hops) fluctuate and directly impact production costs. The company cannot always pass these increases on to selling prices due to competition.
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned at the beginning of Item 7A section with moderate intensity language ('principal market risks'). Exhaustive enumeration of affected commodities (aluminum, sugar, sweeteners, juice concentrates, milk, coffee, hops, malt). Stable but structural trend. Macroeconomic category carries significant weight for beverage sector.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risk on International Operations
risks.summary: 41% of sales come from international markets. Exchange rate fluctuations can reduce revenues when converted to dollars. The company uses foreign exchange contracts for partial hedging but does not consider a 10% variation significant.
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified in middle of Item 7A section with moderate language ('subject to risks'). Exposure quantified: 41% of sales outside the United States in 2025. Partial hedging in place (forward contracts up to 3 months). Stable but increasing trend with international expansion strategy. Standard macroeconomic weight.

risks.title: Limited Ability to Pass Through Costs
risks.summary: Even when commodity costs rise, the company cannot always increase selling prices due to strong competition. This compresses profit margins.
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly stated in middle of Item 7A section with direct language ('ability to recover increased costs through higher pricing is limited'). Structural factor linked to competitive environment. Stable but chronic trend. Competition category carries significant weight for commoditized sector.

risks.title: Limited Availability of Raw Materials
risks.summary: Supply of aluminum cans and certain packaging materials may be limited. The company generally does not hedge against these supply risks, except for aluminum.
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified at the beginning of Item 7A section with moderate language ('limitations in the availability'). Specifically mentioned for aluminum cans and other packaging materials. No hedging through derivative instruments (except aluminum). Stable trend. Standard industrial weight for manufacturing sector.

risks.title: Forward-Looking Statement Risks
risks.summary: Actual results may differ significantly from company forecasts due to unforeseeable uncertainties. The company does not commit to updating its forward-looking statements.
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned at the beginning of Item 1A with standard disclaimer language ('could cause actual results to differ materially'). Generic and mandatory wording. Stable trend (standard clause). Low regulatory weight as legal disclaimer not specific to MNST.
